label: XGS-PON ONT 1x 10GE
notes: ITU-T G.9807.1 Table B.9.3: ONU sensitivity -28.0 dBm and minimum overload -9.0 dBm for every ODN class (N1/N2/E1/E2), met in the presence of G-PON and video overlay. Upstream mean launch per Table B.9.4: +4.0..+9.0 dBm. The class names describe the ODN loss the pair may span, not a difference in ONU receiver: a -28 dBm ONT is the N2-class receiver as much as the N1 one. A GPON OLT and an XGS-PON ONT cannot share a PON port; the engine refuses the pair. Replace with the bought ONT's datasheet before construction.
